title: Huang et al. (2004, 2010) & Pinto & Ermentrout (2001) Wilson-Cowan / Pinto-Ermentrout Neocortical Spiral Wave Dynamics & Phase Singularity Topology

primary_papers.citation: Huang X, Xu W, Liang J, Takagaki K, Gao X, Wu JY (2010) Spiral Waves in Neocortex. Journal of Neuroscience 30(30):10158-10164
Huang X, Troy WC, Yang Q, Ma H, Laing CR, Schiff SJ, Wu JY (2004) Spiral Waves in Disinhibited Mammalian Neocortex. Journal of Neuroscience 24(44):9897-9902
Pinto DJ, Ermentrout GB (2001) Spatially Structured Activity in Synaptically Coupled Neuronal Networks: I. Traveling Fronts and Pulses. SIAM Journal on Applied Mathematics 62(1):206-225
Townsend RG, Solomon SS, Chen SC, Pietersen ANJ, Martin PR, Solomon SG, Gong P (2015) Emergence of Complex Wave Patterns in Primate Cerebral Cortex. Journal of Neuroscience 35(11):4657-4662

governing_equations.pinto_ermentrout_wilson_cowan_pde: tau_u * du(x,t)/dt = -u + D_u * nabla^2 u + F(w_ee * (K_e * u)(x,t) - g_a * a(x,t) + I_ext),   tau_a * da(x,t)/dt = -a + u
governing_equations.sigmoidal_firing_rate_and_kernel: F(z) = 1 / (1 + exp(-beta_f * (z - theta_f))),   K_e(r) = (1 / (2 * pi * sigma_e^2)) * exp(-r^2 / (2 * sigma_e^2))
governing_equations.hilbert_phase_and_topological_winding: Z(x,t) = (u - u_bar) + i * (a - a_bar) = A(x,t) * exp(i * phi(x,t)),   W = (1 / (2*pi)) * oint_C nabla phi . dl in {-1, 0, +1}
governing_equations.radial_core_amplitude_reduction: A(r) = A_inf * tanh(r / r_core),   A(x_core) = 0 at the topological phase singularity (Huang et al. 2010 Fig. 3)
governing_equations.spiral_dispersion_and_chirality_conserva: lambda_spiral = c_wave / f_rot,   sum_i W_i = 0 for spiral pairs nucleated from a broken planar wave front

experimental_regimes.description: Counterclockwise (W = +1) rotating neocortical spiral wave in partially disinhibited tangential slice (Huang et al. 2004, 2010): 10.5 Hz theta/alpha rotation with sharp phase singularity core amplitude drop A(0) -> 0
Clockwise (W = -1) mirror-chirality rotating spiral wave: identical rotation frequency f_rot and radial core deficit A(r) = A_inf tanh(r/r_core) with opposite topological charge W = -1
Broken planar cortical wave front nucleating a counter-rotating chirality-neutral spiral pair (W_+ = +1, W_- = -1, net topological charge sum W_i = 0, Huang et al. 2004 Fig. 4 & Townsend et al. 2015)
Pinto & Ermentrout (2001) expanded horizontal excitatory footprint (sigma_e = 0.63 mm, D_u = 0.024 mm^2/ms): increases wave propagation speed c approx 66 mm/s and spiral wavelength lambda = c / f_rot
Unbroken planar cortical traveling wave front across the 6x6 mm tangential sheet: uniform phase gradient without topological defects (W_total = 0, N_singularities = 0)

Huang et al. (2004, 2010) CNQX / AMPA glutamatergic receptor blockade control (w_ee = 0.8 < w_crit): sub-Hopf trace Tr(J_0) < 0 abolishes self-sustained spiral oscillation and collapses wave amplitude
